headline: Brazil Markets Price in Pause to Selic Rate Cuts Amid Shift in Expectations
summary: Financial market pricing shifted to favor a pause in Brazil's Selic interest rate cut cycle at the upcoming central bank meeting, following five consecutive reductions.
why: The Selic rate is Brazil's benchmark monetary policy tool, directly dictating domestic borrowing costs, corporate debt servicing expenses, and fixed-income yields.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: A potential pause in monetary easing affects domestic yield differentials, influencing foreign capital flows into local fixed income.

why_moved: Shifting expectations toward a halt in interest rate cuts alter the anticipated return profile for local bonds, prompting adjustments in fixed-income and currency portfolios.
